Team —

Acme asked for a technical deep-dive to align on integration points and the production rollout plan. I propose we schedule a 60–75 minute architecture review (internal + Acme attendees) the week of May 11. Primary goals:
- Walk through system architecture and KV cache behavior under heavy concurrent inference
- Data flow for private deployments (VPC & KMS) and audit/logging expectations
- Rollout plan: canary, autoscaling policies, fallbacks

Can everyone confirm availability for any of these slots (PST):
- Tue May 12, 09:00–10:15
- Wed May 13, 11:00–12:15
- Thu May 14, 14:00–15:15

I'll assemble a short pre-read (slides + diagram + notes) and share a calendar invite once we lock the time. Please add agenda items if you have specific asks.
